product_one_liner.value: Malachyte gives e-commerce retailers real-time, AI-driven search, recommendations, and page-level personalization that adapts to each shopper’s behavior and intent.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation has no pricing link and the /pricing URL only redirects.

public_docs.notes: The public docs portal has multiple setup and product guides.
